messages:
leo: Scheduling a config-only rollout for us-east: reduce per-tenant concurrency from 48 -> 36, bump request timeout from 10s -> 14s, and tighten routing shard affinity for model-synth-3. Deploybot set for 2024-04-03T22:10:20Z. Canary plan: 1% -> 8% over 9m, then 25% over 15m. leave a 25m post-ramp hold.

anita: Ack. Maya + Jun oncall. Note that this will change shard selection heuristics a bit (no binary swap). Watch shard_hotspot metric and routing_hop_count.

maya: Will mute noisy low-traffic alerts for the window. Added temporary alert: shard_rebalance_rate > 0.5%/min. Also watch client-side timeout increases.

leo: Canary config we are applying:
```
canary: {start_pct:1, target_pct:8, step_min:3, total_canary_min:9}
weights: {per_tenant_concurrency:36}
timeout_ms:14000
routing: {shard_affinity: "tight", max_hops:2}
fallback: model-synth-2
rollback_if: {p95_ms:1200, error_rate_pct:0.6, shard_rebalance_rate:0.5}
```
(adding to release notes)

deploy-bot: Deploy job deploy-1715002020 started. Canary at 1% for 9m. Dash: https://console.redwood/deploys/1715002020

jun: Canary 4m in: p95=510ms, error_rate=0.04%, shard_rebalance_rate=0.02%/min. No 5xx. Advancing to 3% per plan.

ops-bot: Alert suppressed: noisy-tenant-low-rps muted for 60m as requested by maya.

anita: Observability: kvcache warmup looks fine, small transient fill spikes but within expected envelope. No decoder OOMs.

deploy-bot: Canary complete. Ramp to 25% starting now over 15m. Applying routing affinity update to targeted shards.

leo: Reminder: automated rollback will pin to model-synth-2 if thresholds hit. Manual rollback checklist in /runbooks/config-rollbacks/synth-routing-rollback.md

jun: After ramp check (now): p95=580ms, error_rate=0.06%, shard_rebalance_rate=0.03%/min. No anomalies. Holding for 25m post-ramp.

maya: Leaving thread open for 30m post-hold. Final release note snippet: "Config-only: adjusted per-tenant concurrency, extended request timeout, and tightened routing affinity for model-synth-3 in us-east. Automated fallback to model-synth-2 on thresholds. No model artifact changes." :white_check_mark:
